in_hebrew.name: Firestone
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Stone of Fire
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Firestone הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'pyros' meaning 'fire' and 'lithos' meaning 'stone'. In ancient Greece, firestones were used to create fire, representing strength, vitality, and the power of the divine.

in_greek.name: Firestone
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Stone of Fire
in_greek.long_meaning: Firestone είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'pyros' meaning 'fire' and 'lithos' meaning 'stone'. In ancient Greece, firestones were used to create fire, representing strength, vitality, and the power of the divine.

in_latin.name: Firestone
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Stone of Fire
in_latin.long_meaning: Firestone est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'pyros' meaning 'fire' and 'lithos' meaning 'stone'. In ancient Greece, firestones were used to create fire, representing strength, vitality, and the power of the divine.
